ranked.headline: Generative models forecast single-cell state transitions from transcriptomic snapshots
ranked.summary: Snapshot-based forecasting is now paired with simulation-derived ground truth for evaluating fate and trajectory predictions.

ranked.headline: Error control and batch evaluation in transcriptomic differential expression testing
ranked.summary: Multi-platform transcriptomic datasets now demand DE tests with quantified Type I error control, power, and batch-effect evaluation.

ranked.headline: Pretrained biological foundation models repurposed for protein and omics prediction
ranked.summary: Pretrained protein and omics models are now probed mechanistically and adapted via low-N data, knowledge transfer, and multimodal fusion.

ranked.headline: Computational tools integrate gene, pathway and metabolite data to prioritize and…
ranked.summary: Early-2026 preprints extend computational gene prioritization to LLM literature mining and enrichment interpretation tooling.

ranked.headline: Learned encodings underpin protein-ligand, peptide-protein and molecular design tasks
ranked.summary: Large DEL screens and peptide datasets now train transferable representations for binding prediction and chiral peptide design.

ranked.headline: Multi-ancestry and co-expression QTL models link variants to genes and disease
ranked.summary: Relatedness-aware molQTL tools, trans-eQTL imputation and xQTL-GWAS integration now move variant associations toward gene-level targets.

ranked.headline: Supervised models predict peptide properties, cyclization, and enzyme promiscuity
ranked.summary: Recent items add standardized peptide benchmarks, synthesis-linked cyclization prediction, and enzyme ranking tools reported against rule-based approaches.

ranked.headline: Robust medical image latents via topology, synthetic pretraining, and registration
ranked.summary: Recent preprints probe whether medical image latents stay informative under scanner variation, synthetic supervision, and lesion-preserving alignment.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of cancer genome and transcriptome states from sequencing data
ranked.summary: Higher-resolution sequencing readouts from cfDNA, single cells, and individual haplotypes now enable profiling beyond bulk tumor averages.

ranked.headline: Models link cell-level interactions to emergent tissue patterning and phenotypes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications model how local cell interactions, gene circuit coupling and protease competition generate tissue-scale behavior.

ranked.headline: Trained networks recover connectivity and self-sustained dynamics of neural assemblies
ranked.summary: Two new preprints and a published theory paper extend trained network models to simulated assembly connectivity, latent dynamics, and balanced states.

ranked.headline: Physical priors steer biomolecular diffusion toward ensembles and free-energy ranking
ranked.summary: Physics-based biasing, potentials and restraints are now being layered onto pretrained generative and structure models for biomolecules.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of epigenomic and regulatory states from indirect data
ranked.summary: Sequence, expression and single-cell chromatin proxies are increasingly used in place of direct epigenomic assays across ageing, cancer and Alzheimer's studies.

ranked.headline: Constrained models attribute cortical response features to specific model components
ranked.summary: Mechanistic accounts of V1 modulation and ventral object learning now link specific neural phenomena to individual model components.

ranked.headline: Probabilistic and null-model methods recover hidden structure from sparse omics data
ranked.summary: Sparse, indirect readouts in spatial, chromatin, lineage and expression data call for explicit null models and generative inference.

ranked.headline: Computational methods expose hidden sequence and structure features in proteins and RNA
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply suboptimal alignment exploration, spectral diversity measures, and geometric motif matching to sequence and structure inference.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomes tie lineage-specific gene evolution to methylation and ecology
ranked.summary: New comparative assemblies in myxozoans, Hydra, ants and turtles test gene-level evolution within synteny, epigenetic and multivariate frameworks.

ranked.headline: Learned and docking-based screens target TDP-43, P-gp and GPCR allosteric sites
ranked.summary: Recent preprint and publications pair learned models and docking with experimental validation of ligands and designed allosteric modulators.

ranked.headline: Machine learning predicts pathogen resistance and host infection potential from sequence
ranked.summary: Rapid, genotype-based computational tools are being developed to call resistance and infection potential directly from sequence data.

ranked.headline: Learned models of genomic, protein and nanobody sequence and structure
ranked.summary: Recent preprints report tokenizer-free genomic models, reduced-alphabet protein language models and structure predictors claiming gains over AlphaFold 3.

ranked.headline: Learned models and physicochemical priors refine peptide identification in proteomics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair predictive peptide models with rescoring and missingness handling across DIA, XL-MS, and label-free workflows.

ranked.headline: Local platforms structure sequencing metadata for reproducible omics data management
ranked.summary: Locally deployable tools now pair structured metadata management with portable packaging for multi-omics and sequencing outputs.

ranked.headline: Learned and likelihood-based inference for noisy, high-dimensional genomic data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply EM, Adam, and ML imputation to scale genomic inference and recover missing or ambiguous data.

ranked.headline: Computational models link viral evolution, S. aureus genetics and TCR repertoires
ranked.summary: Cohorts of 806 bacterial genomes and over 1,200 TCR repertoires now let computational models be tested against concrete biological readouts.

ranked.headline: Models infer post-mortem interval and circadian time from routine molecular data
ranked.summary: Routine blood metabolomics and single-sample profiles are being repurposed as quantitative estimates of time since death and internal circadian time.

ranked.headline: New computational tools extract structural and dynamic features from complex data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published framework address structural inference from crowded assembly, molecular dynamics, and cryo-ET datasets.

ranked.headline: Flexible models matched to data structure drive new genomic inference software
ranked.summary: Recent tools pair flexible models with preprocessing suited to sparse, compositional, phylogenetic, and redundant genomic data.

ranked.headline: Mechanism-resolved and calibrated variant effect classes reshape diagnostic interpretation
ranked.summary: Large-scale functional variant data and mechanism-resolved mutation classes are enabling calibrated reclassification and gene-level prioritization.

ranked.headline: Harmonized senescence data and liver spatial pipelines enable cell-type aging analysis
ranked.summary: Harmonized senescence resources and AI-guided causal genetics now link aging biology to cell-type and target-level prioritization.

ranked.headline: Deep learning and graph models integrate multi-omics to resolve spatial tissue domains
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply learned joint embeddings across single-cell, spatial, and genomic data to tissue and tumour characterisation.

ranked.headline: Computational tools for microRNA targeting, artificial design and short RNA fragments
ranked.summary: Machine learning and dedicated software now address microRNA target prediction, artificial miRNA design and short RNA fragment identification.

ranked.headline: Geometry-aware and compressed representations are refining cryo-EM particle curation
ranked.summary: Three 2026 preprints apply compressed-space alignment, MD-trained segmentation, and ion mobility restraints to structure analysis and modeling.

ranked.headline: Open platforms couple ligand free energy calculations and AI molecule design workflows
ranked.summary: Recent published tools package AI-designed molecule curation, binding free energy calculation and cloud-based design workflows for practitioners.

ranked.headline: LLM agents couple reasoning to tools for grounded, checkable biomedical analysis
ranked.summary: Zero-shot LLM workflows are now applied to rare disease diagnosis and DIA proteomics peptide identification.

ranked.headline: Tools for viral haplotype phasing, error estimation, and minority variant calling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints target haplotype, error, and minority-variant accuracy, with ONT move-table signals lifting Clair3 indel F1 to 76.70%.

ranked.headline: Genomic inference of admixture, archaic introgression, and early human diversity
ranked.summary: Whole-genome and single-cell datasets now resolve admixture, archaic introgression, and underrepresented human diversity across dog and human populations.

ranked.headline: Containerized and benchmarked pipelines for microbial sequencing and viral profiling
ranked.summary: Recent microbial and viral sequencing pipelines report containerized deployment, offline capability, and benchmarked performance against alternatives.

ranked.headline: Free-energy simulations assign function to transient biomolecular intermediates
ranked.summary: Free-energy landscapes now link transient lipid, membrane, and enzymatic states to function rather than to static folds.

ranked.headline: Modular epidemic simulation and bioinformatics documentation tools for reusable software
ranked.summary: Recent preprints package simulation and documentation tools for scalable reuse, validation and privacy-preserving collaboration.

ranked.headline: Sub-linear placement and sparse optimal graph alignment cut phylogenetic compute costs
ranked.summary: New algorithms target the computational cost of phylogenetic placement, mtDNA tree reconstruction, and sequence-to-graph alignment for pangenomes.
